controls.name: outputDelay
controls.doc: The per-destination output delay travel, the whole-sample delay a route leg or a bus output is aligned with (omx-dsp's omx_idelay.h). max is the delay ring's ceiling: 1000 ms is the live-console norm and a distance ceiling, about 343 m of throw. A surface that offered more than the ring holds would draw travel the DSP clamps away.
